Theme

Latin word

prōvideō

prōvideō, prōvidēre, prōvīdī, prōvīsum

verb, second conjugation; with accusative, or dative (provide for), or nē

foresee; provide for, take care in advance; see to, make provision for

In this lexicon

  • anticipate

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Fam. 9.18.4: āctum dē tē est, nisi prōvidēs (Lewis & Short); Caes. BG 5.8: reī frūmentāriae

  • provide for

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Att. 11.3.3: cūrā et prōvidē nē quid eī dēsit; Caes. BG 5.8: reī frūmentāriae (Lewis & Short)

Examples

  • āctum dē tē est, nisi prōvidēs

    you’re done for unless you look aheadCic. Fam. 9.18.4 (Lewis & Short)

    In the entry for anticipate

  • quī anticipēs ejus reī molestiam, quam trīduō scītūrus sīs

    for you to suffer in advance over a matter you will know about in three daysCic. Att. 8.14 (Lewis & Short)

    In the entry for anticipate

  • Hoc nēmō prōvīderat.

    Nobody had seen this coming.composed
